rows.author: I105
rows.mother_status: Republic Act RA11466 enacted on 2020-01-08
rows.title_full: AN ACT ADJUSTING THE SALARY SCHEDULE OF CIVILIAN PERSONNEL IN THE GOVERNMENT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Intends to implement a salary schedule that is generally comparable with those in the private sector doing comparable work and in accordance with the provisions of existing salary and position classifications laws, in order to attract, retain and motivate a corps of competent civil servants.

Declares that the Salary Schedule shall apply to all positions for civilian government personnel in the three branches of government, including Constitutional Commissions, SUCs, GOCCs not covered by R.A. 10149, GFIs and LGUs.

Provides that the DBM and CSC shall jointly review the CPCS every three (3) years, develop and recommend to the President a competitive compensation and remuneration system which shall attract and retain talent.
rows.status: Consolidated into HB05712

rows.mother_status: Republic Act RA11466 enacted on 2020-01-08
rows.title_full: AN ACT MODIFYING THE SALARY SCHEDULE FOR CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT PERSONNEL
rows.abstract:
Aims to revise or update the existing Compensation and Position Classification System (CPCS) to conform with a compensation structure that is highly competitive with the private sector; and raising of the minimum salary for Salary Grade 1 to ELEVEN THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED FIFTY-SIX PESOS (P11,656.00).

Proposes that the modified Salary Schedule shall apply to all civilian personnel regardless of appointment status, whether regular, contractual or casual; appointive or elective; and on full-
time or part-time basis.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A NATIONAL DEFENSE ACT, TO FOSTER THE SUPPRESSION OF INSURGENCY AND OTHER SERIOUS THREATS TO NATIONAL SECURITY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to create a comprehensive National Defense Act to ensure accountability and uprightness in police exercise of discretion as well as to achieve efficiency and effectiveness of its members and units in the performance of their functions.

Mandates the DND to support the AFP on matters involving suppression of insurgency, except in cases where the President shall call on the DND to support the AFP in combat operations. In time of national emergency, the PNP, BFP and the BJMP shall assist the armed forces in meeting the national emergency.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE AND SECURITY since 2019-08-06
